clients.name: Claude (web, desktop and mobile)
steps: Open Customize, then Connectors.
Select + Add, then Add custom connector.
Name it Sozee and paste the server URL: https://mcp.sozee.ai/mcp
Select Continue, keep the detected sign-in settings, then Add.
Connect and sign in to your Sozee account.
On Team and Enterprise plans an owner adds it under Organization settings, Connectors (Add, Custom, Web); members then select Connect.

clients.name: ChatGPT
steps: Go to chatgpt.com/plugins.
Select the plus button, then Add custom MCP server.
Name it Sozee and add a short description.
Under Connection choose Public endpoint and paste the server URL: https://mcp.sozee.ai/mcp
Choose OAuth for authentication, review the warning and continue.
Select Create as a plugin, then sign in to your Sozee account.
Your account or workspace settings decide whether custom MCP servers are allowed.

clients.name: Claude Code
steps: Add the marketplace and install the plugin (commands above), or run: claude mcp add --transport http sozee https://mcp.sozee.ai/mcp
Run /mcp and sign in to Sozee.

clients.name: Cursor
steps: Open the link to install, or add the config to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (all projects) or .cursor/mcp.json (one project).
Sign in to Sozee when Cursor asks.

clients.name: VS Code
steps: Open the link and select Install, or add the config to .vscode/mcp.json.
Sign in to Sozee when VS Code asks.

clients.name: VS Code Insiders
steps: Open the link and select Install.
Sign in to Sozee when asked.

clients.name: Codex CLI
steps: Add this to ~/.codex/config.toml, or run: codex mcp add sozee --url https://mcp.sozee.ai/mcp
Run: codex mcp login sozee

clients.name: Gemini CLI
steps: Install the extension with the command above.
Sign in to Sozee when Gemini CLI asks.

clients.name: Antigravity
steps: Add this to ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (all projects) or .agents/mcp_config.json (one project), or install the plugin in antigravity/sozee from a clone of this repo with: agy plugin install ./antigravity/sozee
Authenticate Sozee under Customizations, Installed, MCP Servers.

clients.name: Zed
steps: Add this to your Zed settings.json.
Sign in to Sozee when Zed asks.

clients.name: Devin Desktop and CLI
steps: Add this to ~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json (all projects) or .devin/mcp_config.json (one project).
Select Authenticate when Sozee shows Needs authentication.
